title: 679. Remove 9

examples.explanation: Counting 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,10 shows the 9th kept number is 10.
The next kept number after 10 is 11.

hints: Write down the kept numbers: skipping anything containing digit 9 leaves exactly the base-9 counting sequence read as decimal.
Convert n to base 9, then read those digits as an ordinary decimal number.
Build the answer digit by digit with repeated division by 9.
